blurb: Guests experience guided fly fishing in remote Alaskan wilderness near Juneau targeting various salmon and trout species depending on season. All fishing trips are private and include instruction tailored to skill level. Glacier sightseeing tours offer 3-5 hour boat trips to a tidewater glacier with wildlife viewing opportunities.
extraNote: Trips canceled more than 30 days in advance fully refunded minus $50 cancellation fee · All fishing is catch & release; no fish kept or processed · Gratuities appreciated; 15-20% for fishing trips, 10-20% for sightseeing tours · Guides carry bear spray as precaution; no bear incidents reported · Pick-up and drop-off directly from the cruise ship port
